title: Check eligibility for the Pío Pico specialist posting
detail: Subject-specific classification requirements may limit eligibility. If expired, pivot to docent program.

title: Contact Pío Pico about volunteer docent training
detail: Ask about training, realistic duties and schedule.

title: Apply for a Gilb Museum volunteer shift
Attend a John Moran auction preview
detail: Talk to staff about receiving, cataloging, previews and client service.

title: Explore California Botanic Garden volunteer opportunities
detail: Compare guide work with grounds and nursery work.

title: Talk to a coin dealer or attend a show
detail: Ask about counterfeits, training, security and junior roles.

title: Set minimum sustainable income and runway
detail: Estimate take-home pay, benefits and acceptable training costs.

title: Complete at least two guided or public-program shifts
detail: Evaluate actual work: speaking, repetition, walking, administration.

title: Try one physical garden or fabrication shift
detail: Test tolerance for repetitive work and outdoor conditions.

title: Assist in a supervised beginner class
detail: Find out whether teaching brings energy or fatigue.

title: Design and deliver one local history walk
detail: Track route research, safety, public speaking and booking demand.

title: Research five collectible editions or objects
detail: Write condition notes, compare sold prices and learn provenance.

title: Score three real-world work experiments
detail: Prefer observed enjoyment, movement and sustainability over job titles.

title: Confirm credentials and experience for the top role
detail: Use official classification and employer requirements.

title: Apply to five truly eligible roles in the chosen field
detail: Tailor the résumé around portable business and operational skills.

title: Choose a primary track and a fallback
detail: Do not change income sources until financial needs are understood.
